title: Copilot Studio: share agents with other makers on the Microsoft Copilot harness
summary: The briefing is held because it reports the administrator roles for limiting sharing as undocumented, although Microsoft documents the roles required to edit Managed Environments. The roadmap facts, sharing path and PowerShell example are supported; the differing descriptions of Viewer access and licensing also need clarification.
